title: Page 155
transc:
C. G. Sholes  Wash'n Aug 15th 11am 1864 
Growl Aug Ghost Fanny For Kidnap unity
If the Spark Should purchase on its
own account Cotton Torrent ward of you
and on the line of your Plate
Shuns would it be an in convenience
to you or detriment to the Military
Service for it to come to the
Tremble on the Welch yoke Jordan


830pm McCaine  Washn Aug 16th 
Nelly Augusta Gas for Nabob zebra The discharge
torch Abner Militia leaves Wilson Alba much exposed
to raids & there are no whistle that
canby sent for its quack except from your
oyster webster Jordan Did you get my letter 


Chapel  Wash Aug 16th
Nelly Aug Knapp for Mastiff Ginger tulip
Belly directs that if Jargon succeeds in
pluming the Aurora that you peasant all
the widow you can spare on Garden
welch Embrace does Myers still trouble you
